title: Power Up
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about powers. The exit is up on a ledge too high to jump, until a star gives you high jumps. A canyon is too wide to cross, until a pair of sneakers lets you run and leap twice as far. A power is a block that adds to a counter, so it lasts for jumps or strides, not seconds. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how much a star gives.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie has two short levels to cross. The exit sits on a ledge too high to reach, until a star gives them high jumps. A canyon is too wide to jump, until a pair of sneakers lets them run and leap twice as far. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how much a star gives.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A star gives four high jumps; sneakers give fifty fast strides
Made to be copied and taken apart
